        : { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px', threshold: .08 });
      revealSections.forEach((section) => revealObserver.observe(section));

    const requestHeroDepth = () => {

    };

      if (shouldListen === heroDepthListening) return;
      window[shouldListen ? 'addEventListener' : 'removeEventListener']('scroll', requestHeroDepth, { passive: true });
      heroDepthListening = shouldListen;
    };
    const handleHeroPointer = (event) => {
      if (!hero || !precisePointer.matches || reduceMotion.matches || window.PDPMotion.desktop.matches) return;
      const bounds = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = (event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width - .5;
      const y = (event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height - .5;
      hero.style.setProperty('--hero-pointer-x', `${(x * 7).toFixed(2)}px`);
      hero.style.setProperty('--hero-pointer-y', `${(y * 5).toFixed(2)}px`);
    };

      hero?.style.setProperty('--hero-pointer-x', '0px');
      hero?.style.setProperty('--hero-pointer-y', '0px');
    };

    syncHeroDepthListener();
    hero?.addEventListener('pointermove', handleHeroPointer, { passive: true });
    hero?.addEventListener('pointerleave', resetHeroPointer);

      hero?.removeEventListener('pointermove', handleHeroPointer);
      hero?.removeEventListener('pointerleave', resetHeroPointer);
      reduceMotion.removeEventListener?.('change', handleMotionPreference);
      window.PDPMotion.desktop.removeEventListener?.('change', handleMotionPreference);
    };

    documents: `${pages}09-documents-materials.html`,
    contacts: `${pages}10-contacts.html`,
    privacy: `${pages}12-privacy-policy.html`
  };

  const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav a');
  [null, routes.services, routes.cases, routes.contacts, routes.articles].forEach((href, index) => {
    if (href && navLinks[index]) navLinks[index].href = href;
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.top-cta, .hero .btn.hot, .project-showcase-discuss').forEach((link) => {
    link.href = routes.contacts;
  });
  document.querySelector('.hero .btn:not(.hot)')?.setAttribute('href', routes.projects);
  document.querySelector('.about-action')?.setAttribute('href', routes.about);
  document.querySelectorAll('.articles .article').forEach((link) => {
    link.href = routes.articleDetail;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/articles/"]').forEach((link) => {
    link.href = routes.articleDetail;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href="../privacy.html"]').forEach((link) => {
    link.href = routes.privacy;
  });

  const footerColumns = document.querySelectorAll('.footer > div');
  const footerNavigation = footerColumns[1]?.querySelectorAll('a');
  [null, routes.services, routes.projects, routes.articles, routes.contacts].forEach((href, index) => {
    if (href && footerNavigation?.[index]) footerNavigation[index].href = href;
  });
  footerColumns[2]?.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((link) => {
    link.href = routes.services;
  });
})();
</script>
